CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_section_lifecycle_command(p_mutation_id text, p_device_id text, p_command text, p_section_id text, p_archive_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_client_updated_at bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
      if auth.uid() is null then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Authentication required'; end if;
      perform rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid());
      return rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_section_lifecycle_command_before_student_0029(p_mutation_id,p_device_id,p_command,p_section_id,p_archive_date,p_client_updated_at); end; $function$
